title: Chapter 355 Gods
content:
Chapter 355 Gods

Thinking of this, Lu Daosheng popped out his hands, and a gentle force suddenly surged out of Lu Daosheng's hand and headed towards the end of the void.

In just a moment, an invisible force instantly enveloped the entire Blue Star.

As long as Lu Dao is born and immortal, Blue Star will definitely be worry-free.

After doing all this, Lu Daosheng continued to set off with confidence.

Buzz rumble-

There were again a burst of attractive aura in the gap in front of me, as if warning the visitor not to go in.

But Lu Daosheng ignored it and still strides forward, striding freely in the garden.

At the same time, Lu Daosheng suddenly felt something, and a comfortable breath could not stop all over his body, rushing straight to the sky spiritual cover.

The next moment, a familiar voice sounded from my mind.

[Ding, congratulations to the host, the system upgrade is successful]

upgrade?

Lu Daosheng was confused, but he still couldn't hide the joy of the system's return.

"system?"

【exist】

"You upgraded?"

【yes】

"Open the system panel."

【Name: Lu Daosheng】

【Identity: Lord of the Desert City】

【Land of Realm: Demigod (upgradable)】

【System Point: ∞】

【System Store】

Looking at the system panel that had not been seen for a long time, Lu Daosheng quickly noticed his realm.

Demigod.

This is something he hadn't seen before.

It turns out that he has been upgrading, but his realm has always been ∞ and there is no change.

But now, his realm has finally changed again.

This made him understand that the system was not omnipotent.

Just like before, before the system is upgraded, no matter how you advance to the realm, it has no effect.

Now, it may be different.

"System, cultivation level upgrade."

Lu Daosheng called out in his heart.

The next moment, a breath suddenly surged in his body.

Immediately afterwards, Lu Daosheng's physique suddenly began to undergo a huge change.

The strong change made Lu Daosheng unable to help but hum.

Cool.

It took me a long time before this feeling began to slowly dissipate.

At this moment, Lu Daosheng had already been reborn, and every move was filled with unparalleled power.

At this time, Lu Daosheng seemed to feel something, and looked up.

A divine light shot out from Lu Daosheng's eyes.

The originally hazy gap instantly became much clearer.

"Did you upgrade the system because I found it?"

Lu Daosheng asked suddenly.

The system was silent for a moment.

【yes】

really.

It seems that the system is capable, but it needs to take the initiative to stimulate the system's capabilities.

But he knew that there were still some things in the system deliberately hiding them from him.

After a moment of silence, Lu Daosheng shook his head gently.

Let these things be put aside first.

What is in front of him attracts his interest more.

"System, continue to upgrade."

.........

Above a desolate plain, there is endless view, and the world is filled with an inexplicable sense of oppression, which makes people feel suffocated.

And at the end of the plain, a huge palace that reaches the sky can be vaguely seen, standing there like a giant.

In front of the palace, there is a statue.

laugh!

At this moment, the space in the distance suddenly cracked.

The next moment, a man in a robe slowly walked out of it.

"Is this the new world?"

Looking at the desolate scene in front of him, Lu Daosheng had no expression on his face.

After looking forward to a new world for many years, now that he has arrived, he finds that his mood is particularly calm.

After a moment of silence, Lu Daosheng slowly walked towards the palace at the end.

Lu Daosheng walked a little slowly.

Along the way, Lu Daosheng saw a strange scene.

There was pungent blood everywhere, and there were broken corpses everywhere.

The surrounding aura was even more chaotic, as if there was an epic battle here not long ago.

Lu Daosheng walked for a long time and finally arrived in front of the hall.

Lu Daosheng did not look at the hall as soon as possible, but looked at the statue in front of the hall.

The Heaven-Brushing Stone.

The entire statue is made of the Sky Stone, which is extremely luxurious.

But the statue at this moment was a bit broken, and its face was almost wiped out. It was only possible to barely see that it was a human figure.

But it is unknown whether they are from the human race.

"interesting."

After looking at it for a moment, Lu Daosheng smiled faintly and then walked into the palace.

And just after Lu Daosheng left, a faint light suddenly emanated from the statue standing there.

"Pilgrim, are you here to seek my protection?"

"Let your mind and give everything you have to me, and you will have eternal life!"

As soon as Lu Daosheng stepped onto the steps of the palace, a rough and majestic voice came from inside the palace.

The sound was extremely terrifying. If Lu Daosheng had come here, he might have just heard this cry and his soul would be destroyed, and everything would be gone.

Is there a terrifying strong man hidden in this dilapidated palace? !

"Eternal life? Hoho, ridiculous!"

Lu Daosheng sneered, not caring about the voice at all.

Thumb, Thumb, Thumb,

Lu Daosheng continued to walk into the palace.

As the last step was passed by Lu Daosheng, the terrifying voice sounded again from the depths of the palace.

"From ancient times, those who worship gods have all knelt down and prayed with pious hearts. Why do you dare to be so rude?"

This time, the entire plain began to tremble wildly.

The huge palace trembled violently, as if it was afraid of the creatures in the palace.

The world is also changing dramatically, howling and moaning.

God!

The mysterious creatures in the palace actually call themselves gods!

Lu Daosheng's face became more and more cold, and his eyes looked into the palace, leaving only the coldness like thousands of years of black ice.

"Kneel down and beg? Who gives you the courage!"

Bang!

As Lu Daosheng took a sudden step forward.

The entire palace suddenly began to shake, and then Lu Daosheng clenched his fists and punched him out.

This punch has no blessing, it is Lu Daosheng's ultimate power.

In an instant, an invincible aura surged out from Lu Daosheng's fist, carrying terrifying power towards the depths of the palace.

Buzz —

The space began to twist, and the palace was silent for a moment.

The next moment, rumble!

The deafening explosion sounded.

The entire palace was destroyed by Lu Daosheng's punch.

Looking at the palace where there was only a ruin in front of him, Lu Daosheng shouted coldly: "You dare to pretend to be a ghost in front of me. Even if you are really here, I will kill you like a ants!"

As the words fell, the scene fell into silence again.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng snorted and continued to walk far away, leaving only a piece of ruins behind him and the dilapidated statue.

I don't know how long it took.

Lu Daosheng walked across the plain and came into a quiet starry sky.

The stars are shining, and countless galaxies flash by in front of their eyes.

Lu Daosheng looked into the distance, but his brows frowned slightly.

As Lu Daosheng approached, two corpses appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.
